sloka: न अतन्त्री वाद्यते वीणा न अचक्रः वर्तते रथः ।न अपतिः सुखम् एधते या स्यात् अपि शत आत्मजा ॥२-३९-२९॥
transliteration: na atantrī vādyate vīṇā na acakraḥ vartate rathaḥ ।na apatiḥ sukham edhate yā syāt api śata ātmajā ॥2-39-29॥

translations.english: A veena (lute) sans strings cannot be played. A chariot without wheels cannot move. Similarly, a woman without her husband finds no happiness even though she has one hundred sons.
